First tagged release of the Beyond Signal science discovery directory.

## Highlights

- Full discovery catalog through June 2026 with real, credited imagery
- Entity hubs: categories, subtopics, tags, locations, organizations, and authors
- SEO foundation: canonical URLs, JSON-LD structured data, sitemap, and per-discovery OpenGraph/Twitter social cards rendered as PNG at build time
- Editorial pages: methodology, editorial standards, and corrections
- Saved collections, interactive map, timeline, and tree explorers
- Optional Notion sync (`npm run sync:notion`) as the catalog source of truth
